create_lru_cache: create an LRU cache with a specified maxsize and generic key/value types
test_cache_eviction: test that the least recently used item is evicted when maxsize is exceeded
test_cache_access_updates_order: test that accessing a cache item moves it to the most recently used position
test_maxsize_increase: test that increasing maxsize allows more items and trimming removes least recently used
test_maxsize_decrease: test that decreasing maxsize trims the cache to the new size by removing least recently used items
